name: self-improve
description: A weekly self-improvement loop for Claude Code: read-only collectors summarize your last week of sessions, git history and a fixed list of upstream changelogs into digests, a combined digest ranks recurring findings, and an improve step applies at most three small reversible fixes (with backups and a change log) and queues everything bigger for your sign-off. Off until you schedule it; `selfimprove.py off` or SELF_IMPROVE=off skips runs.
